description: This file contains utility functions for importing and migrating chart configurations in the Superset project, including filtering annotations, handling chart import logic with permission checks, and migrating old visualization types to new ones.

classes.name: MigrateViz
classes.description: Base class for migrating visualization types, used in the migration process within migrate_chart.

methods.name: filter_chart_annotations
methods.description: Filters chart configuration to keep only annotations of type FORMULA.

methods.name: import_chart
methods.description: Imports a chart configuration, handling permissions, existing chart updates, annotation filtering, and migration.

methods.name: migrate_chart
methods.description: Migrates old visualization types to new ones using registered migrator classes.
